correctness.rationale: The original full-branch inverse of the generalized Lüroth map has cylinder probability q^{|i|+1}, so the digit exponents are iid with P(X=1)=q and P(X=j)=2q^j (j>=2). A complete renormalization pairs two digits; its multiplier is q^{Z} and W(z)=[qz(1+qz)/(1-qz)]^2. The renewal identity U(z)=1/(1-W(z)) has partial fractions 1/[4(1-z)]+1/[4(1+q^2 z)]+(1-qz)/[2(1+q^2 z^2)], giving exact u_m and the four residue-class asymptotics. The overshoot first-crossing convolution P(H_m=k)=sum_{j=1}^m u_{m-j} w_{j+k} yields the stated F_k and, by dominated convergence plus EZ=4, the normalized limiting mass (1/4)P(Z>=k+1). Independent floating-point renewal convolutions matched the exact hit expression at m=0..40 to 2.4e-15, and normalized overshoot distributions at seven thresholds with exact P(H=0)=u_m, P(H=1)=u_{m+1}. Proof extends to arbitrary m; numerical testing alone does not.
residual_risks: Independent finite verification only tests bounded instances; universal portions follow from reconstructed analytic proof.
